description: Fetch paper lists from PaperCopilot (papercopilot.com), including accepted papers from SIGGRAPH, CVPR, ICCV, ICLR, NeurIPS, ICML, AAAI, ACL, EMNLP and other conferences.

function.description:
要调用的功能名。可用值:
  - list_papers: 获取指定会议和年份的所有论文列表; 需要 conference, year; 参数: conference, year, track; 必填: 无
  - search_paper: 按标题搜索论文; 需要 conference, year, title; 参数: conference, year, title, track; 必填: 无
  - filter_by_session: 按session/area筛选论文; 需要 conference, year, session; 参数: conference, year, session, track; 必填: 无
  - filter_by_status: 按状态筛选论文(如Technical Paper, Poster等); 需要 conference, year, status; 参数: conference, year, status, track; 必填: 无
  - list_conferences: 列出支持的会议列表; 参数: 无; 必填: 无

conference.description:
会议ID(小写)，如 siggraph, cvpr, iccv, iclr, neurips, icml, aaai, acl, emnlp。
用于 list_papers, search_paper, filter_by_session, filter_by_status。

year.description: 年份，如 "2024"。用于 list_papers, search_paper, filter_by_session, filter_by_status。

track.description: 会议track，默认为"main"。大多数会议只有main track。

title.description: 论文标题搜索关键词。用于 search_paper。

session.description: Session/Area筛选关键词，如 "3D Fabrication", "VR"。用于 filter_by_session。

status.description: 状态筛选，如 "Technical Paper", "Poster", "TOG Paper"。用于 filter_by_status。
